reason: The operative contract (problem.txt) requires E = ||out - ref||_2 / max(||ref||_2, 0.001*sqrt(32)) <= 0.001 on the single fully specified make_inputs workload (seed 812, N=64, D=32). Probe t11, which exactly replicates make_inputs, measured E_kernel = 0.00206 with denominator ||ref|| = 0.0742 (above the 0.00566 floor) and all outputs finite — a clear budget violation. Attribution is clean: removing only the fp16 round-trip of softmax probabilities (kernel.py line 15) gives E = 1.05e-6 (claim c2, rebutted), so the entire breach is caused by the fp16 cast. While the contract permits reduced precision in principle, it requires the 0.001 budget to be met, and it is exceeded by ~2x. The claim is in_scope with scope evidence citing the stated workload domain; the mechanism detail (90% vs ~2.4% output shrink) in the claim statement is inaccurate but immaterial to the confirmed measured violation.
